caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray on a light, off-white background. It depicts a single metallic object, which appears to be a pair of tongs with rounded, spoon-shaped ends. The tongs have an engraved decorative border along each arm, featuring a pattern of small leaves and dots. There is a rectangular maker's mark or hallmark visible on the inside of one arm. Below and to the right of the tongs, there is a separate oval emblem that encircles the initials "JKB" in an ornate script, surrounded by an engraved border of small leaves and dots similar to the decoration on the tongs. The entire composition is enclosed within a faint rectangular boundary drawn near the edge of the paper.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
